data.one_liner: A highly customizable styled toast package for Flutter with animations.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to display styled toasts and custom toast widgets with flexible animations, positions, and global configuration options. Supports custom animation builders and duration control.
use_when: You need to display customizable toast messages across your app
You want custom entry and exit animations for notification toasts
avoid_when: You require complex persistent push notifications or local system notifications
strengths: Supports custom widget content inside toasts
weaknesses: Requires passing build context or wrapping the app globally
Limited to in-app toast overlays rather than native OS notifications
